title: SensorReading
description: Optional, clearly-non-gating wearable/sensor input (PRD 4.6 default: symptom entry is mandatory regardless; sensor integration is optional research context only). MUST NOT be referenced by any safety-FSM transition or DecisionEvent.action other than as descriptive evidence.

consentScopeRef.description: Must correspond to a ConsentRecord with 'wearable_integration' in scopes; enforced at the backend-api ingestion endpoint, not by this schema alone.
